# nico_nvlink_logical_partition (Data Source)

NVLink Logical Partitions are used to group GPUs into logical partitions for shared memory and low-latency direct communication between GPUs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_nvlink_logical_partition" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "nvlink_logical_partition_name" {
  value = data.nico_nvlink_logical_partition.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `include_interfaces` (String) Include NVLink Interfaces in response.
- `include_stats` (String) Include NVLink Logical Partition Stats in response.
- `include_vpcs` (String) Include VPCs in response.
- `instance_id` (String) Filter NVLink Interfaces by Instance ID.  Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one ID.
- `nv_link_domain_id` (String) Filter NVLink Interfaces by NVLink Domain ID.  Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one ID.
- `nv_link_logical_partition_id` (String) Filter NVLink Interfaces by NVLink Logical Partition ID.  Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one ID.
- `query` (String) Search for matches across all NVLink Logical Partitions. Input will be matched against name, description, and status fields
- `site_id` (String) Filter NVLink Logical Partitions by Site
- `status` (String) Filter NVLink Logical Partitions by Status

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date and time the NVLink Logical Partition was created
- `description` (String) Optional description of the NVLink Logical Partition
- `name` (String) Name of the NVLink Logical Partition
- `nv_link_logical_partition_stats` (Attributes) GPU and Instance usage counts for the NVLink Logical Partition. Returned if the `includeStats` query parameter is set to true in retrieval endpoints (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nv_link_logical_partition_stats))
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Details of status changes for the NVLink Logical Partition over time (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenant the NVLink Logical Partition belongs to
- `updated` (String) Date and time the NVLink Logical Partition was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--nv_link_logical_partition_stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nv_link_logical_partition_stats`

Read-Only:

- `total_distinct_instances` (Number) Total number of distinct Instances associated with the NVLink Logical Partition
- `total_gpus` (Number) Total number of GPUs associated with the NVLink Logical Partition


<a id="nestedatt--status_history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_history`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Date/time when the associated entity assumed the status
- `message` (String) Description of the state and cause/remedy in case of error
- `status` (String) State of the associated entity at a particular time
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the associated entity was last observed with this status
